lines.en: When will the writer see the play?
lines.cn: 作家什么时候能看到这部剧呢？

lines.en: 'The play may begin at any moment,' I said.
lines.cn: “这部剧随时都可能上演，”我说。

lines.en: 'It may have begun already,' Susan answered.
lines.cn: “也许它已经上演了，”苏珊回答。

lines.en: I hurried to the ticket office.
'May I have two tickets please?' I asked.
lines.cn: “请给我两张票，好吗？”我请求道。

lines.en: 'I'm sorry, we've sold out,' the girl said.
lines.cn: “很抱歉，票已经卖完了，”女孩说。

lines.en: Just then, a man hurried to the ticket office.
lines.cn: 就在这时，一个男人匆匆跑到了售票处。

lines.en: 'Can I return these two tickets?' he asked.
lines.cn: “我可以退掉这两张票吗？”他问道。

lines.en: I went back to the ticket office at once.
lines.cn: 我立刻又回到了售票处。

lines.en: 'Could I have those two tickets please?' I asked.
lines.cn: “请把那两张票给我，好吗？”我再次请求道。
但这些是用于下周三的演出准备的。

lines.en: 'I might as well have them,' I said sadly.
lines.cn: “我还不如把它们都拿下来呢，”我悲伤地说。
